description: The score API of parasail 1.3.4 for one query against one or many references: the optimal score with its end coordinates (endQuery, endReference: 0-based index of the last aligned residue), the statistics of the optimal alignment WITHOUT a traceback (matches, similar = positive pairs, length: parasail nw_stats / sw_stats / sg_stats), the full score tables (table; with statistics also the matches / similar / length tables) and the last row and column of the score matrix (rowcol), for global (function nw), local (sw) and every semi-global variant (sg = all end gaps free, sg_qb / sg_qe / sg_db / sg_de, sg_qx, sg_dx and the combinations sg_qb_db, sg_qb_de, sg_qe_db, sg_qe_de: q = query, d = database = reference; b = beginning, e = end, x = both ends). Gaps are parasail's affine penalties: a gap of length k costs open + (k - 1) * extend (both >= 0; BLAST-style 11 / 1 is open 11, extend 1). The program keeps O(min(length)) cells (the table needs m * n) and the query is prepared once for the whole list of references (profile reuse); parallel runs the references on all cores. Scoring: matrix (name or text; integer scores) or match / mismatch over the letters of the sequences. VERIFICATION: equal to parasail 1.3.4 (nw, sw and the eleven sg variants x plain, _stats, _table, _rowcol, _stats_table, _stats_rowcol) on 520 / 520 recorded pairs.

references.description: The references (parasail s2, the database sequences), at least one.

function.description: parasail function: nw (global), sw (local) or a semi-global variant sg, sg_qb, sg_qe, sg_db, sg_de, sg_qx, sg_dx, sg_qb_db, sg_qb_de, sg_qe_db, sg_qe_de (default sw).

open.description: Penalty of the first gap position (>= 0; default 11).

extend.description: Penalty of each further gap position (>= 0; default 1).

matrix.description: Optional substitution matrix: any built-in matrix by EMBOSS, NCBI or Biopython name - BLOSUM62, PAM250, EBLOSUM30 ... EBLOSUM90, EPAM10 ... EPAM500, BLASTP (BLOSUM62 with the residues U = selenocysteine, O = pyrrolysine and J = leucine / isoleucine, as blastp scores them), GONNET1992, JONES, DAYHOFF, MDM78, BENNER6 / 22 / 74, JOHNSON, RISLER, GENETIC, FENG, LEVIN, MCLACHLAN, RAO, STR (protein; the fractional ones are scored exactly) or EDNAFULL, EDNAMAT, EDNASIMPLE, ENUC.4.4, BLASTN, MEGABLAST, HOXD70, TRANS (IUPAC DNA); or THE TEXT of a matrix instead of a name: several lines in the NCBI / EMBOSS / Biopython data-file format (a header line of symbols, then one row per symbol: the symbol and its scores; # lines are comments; scores may be decimals). When given, match/mismatch are ignored, residues are scored by the published table (any protein or IUPAC symbol of the matrix; case-insensitive) and gapOpen/gapExtend may be fractional (the EMBOSS needle/water models: gapOpen = -(G - E), gapExtend = -E for -gapopen G -gapextend E). The result then also carries the real-valued exactScore.

match.description: Score of an identical pair when no matrix is given (default 2).

mismatch.description: Score of a different pair when no matrix is given (default -3).

statistics.description: true: matches, similar and length of the optimal alignment (the *_stats functions).

table.description: true: the score tables (and, with statistics, the matches / similar / length tables); at most 4 000 000 cells per reference.

rowcol.description: true: the last row and the last column of the score matrix (the *_rowcol functions).

parallel.description: true: score the references in parallel (the results keep their order).

errors.message: Unknown function, a gap penalty below zero, a letter outside the matrix, an empty reference list or a table above 4 000 000 cells
